title: Effective spread versus last quote
instructions: For each trade, return 2 × absolute difference between trade price and previous same-ticker quote mid, as a Series indexed by trade time.
reference: pd.merge_asof(df.query("event == 'trade'")[["time","symbol","trade_px"]].sort_values("time"), df.query("event == 'quote'").assign(mid=lambda x: (x["bid"]+x["ask"])/2)[["time","symbol","mid"]].sort_values("time"), on="time", by="symbol", direction="backward").set_index("time").eval("2 * abs(trade_px - mid)")
hint: Work inside out. Align every execution with the latest earlier quote for its ticker rather than using future information.

explanation.meaning: Align every execution with the latest earlier quote for its ticker rather than using future information.
Give each output value a trade-time label.
Form a simple effective-spread proxy; no trade-sign inference is needed.
